purpose: Turn a repeatable fixed canvas workflow into native controls that the user can test and keep.
workflow: Translate the user's reusable workflow into the manifest contract below.
Call extension_stage with the complete manifest object.
If validation fails, correct the named field and retry once.
Tell the user the trial is ready. Only the user may run its controls, Keep it, or Discard it.

manifest.id: lowercase stable ID using letters, numbers, dots, dashes, or underscores
manifest.name: 1 to 120 visible characters
permissions: design.write when any button changes the canvas

contributes.sidebar: 1 to 20 panels; each has id, title, and controls

buttonAction.label: undo history label
buttonAction.operations: 1 to 250 create, update, delete, reparent, or reorder operations

node.type: native node type and editable properties

update.id: exact node ID or omit with target=selection

delete.ids: exact IDs or omit with target=selection

controlValues: Use {"$control": "control-id"} anywhere inside a node or patch to insert the current input value.
restrictions: no URLs, files, shell, network, packages, or background behavior
